fusions.name: Measured Dose
fusions.desc: A needle jab that deals 4 poison damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Draw It All Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The puncture deals 20 poison damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Taste of Their Own
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Under the Skin
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 12% poison resistance.
